## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

## About Fluor

Through our people, projects and partnerships, Fluor connects businesses and communities to advance
economies and employment. We create choice and opportunity on a local and global scale.

Building a better world is our purpose. We care deeply about safety and seek to drive quality and
efficiency in all that we do. We behave **ethically**, inclusively and responsibly for a brighter
future.

We support our clients in solving critical challenges. We operate throughout the project lifecycle,
from conceptual design, engineering, procurement and construction to the operations and maintenance
of facilities.

Clients, partners and communities trust Fluor because we are here for the long term – delivering
successful projects of both scale and significance for more than a century. From the spark of an
idea to a project's completion, our nearly 27,000 colleagues in more than 60 locations around the
globe provide professional and technical solutions with world-class expertise.

# Airedale by Modine

## The Critical Cooling Specialists

At Airedale by Modine, we believe that air conditioning has a critical role to play in an
ever-changing world. We also passionately believe that air conditioning manufacturers must play a
responsible role in an era where sustainability is key to the preservation of our planet.

Whether you need to maintain productive and healthy working environments for people or optimised
operating envelopes for critical equipment in data centers and other industries, Airedale by Modine
delivers a tailored solution based on world-class products, industry-leading design, intelligent
software, and unrivalled end-to-end customer support.

#### About Us

Tengshida(Hebei) Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd
Tengshida (Hebei) Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer specializing in the
development and production of industrial chimneys and environmental protection equipment. Located in
Longhua Industrial Park, Hengshui City, Hebei Province, the company has a registered capital of RMB
100 million and occupies an area of 100,000 square meters, including 28,000 square meters of
construction space and 3,600 square meters of office space. The company's product range encompasses
self-standing chimneys, telescopic chimneys, tower chimneys, stainless steel chimneys, FRP chimneys,
and numerous other types. Tengshida employs 89 staff members, among whom are eight engineers holding
master’s degrees or higher, with 60% of employees possessing bachelor’s or associate degrees.

# 关于绿控

][48]

## 新能源商用车驱动系统解决方案提供商

苏州绿控传动科技股份有限公司，成立于2011年，是中国新能源商用车电驱动系统领域的领军企业之一。

公司专注于为客户提供高性能的电驱动系统、核心零部件及相关技术开发服务，凭借在驱动电机、变速器和控制系
统方面掌握的一系列关键核心技术，赋予了产品高可靠性、高效率、一体化与轻量化的显著优势。公司的自主研发
成果，覆盖纯电动、插电式混合动力（含增程式）及燃料电池三种技术路线，广泛应用于商用车与非道路移动机械
领域，并在新能源重卡细分市场占据重要地位。

  绿控中央集成式电驱桥覆盖4.5t-49t轻重卡车型。产品布局早，构型方案成熟，保有量超过20000台
  
  [探索更多**>**][51]
  
  ## 电机
  
  绿控的驱动电机、上装电机及发电机产品，自主设计生产，扭矩功率密度高，应用范围广
  
  [探索更多**>**][52]
  
  ## 变速器
  
  绿控自主设计生产的商用车及矿卡专用变速器。效率高、可靠性强、维护方便

*技术**创新***
  绿控拥有一支高水平的研发和产业化团队，核心研发管理人员均来自国内985、211高校及高端研究机构，主要管
  理层都有着丰富的新能源汽车动力系统的设计、生产及管理经验。

  我们拥有从零件到部件、再到总成的产品开发全周期的验证能力，从设计之初到试制阶段、直到产品批量上市，
  始终贯穿的台架以及整车测试，为产品研发水平的持续提升，提供了坚实的科技保障。
  绿控建立了国内一流的产品开发实验平台；拥有130多台先进的试验设备、70多辆试验车，以及专业完善的实验
  测试流程。绿控的各类产品，采用国际先进的PLM管理系统、通过完全正向开发，经过浸水、高低温、盐雾、振
  动、耐久、噪音、整车路试等146种试验的检验测试，实现了产品可靠性、经济性、动力性、轻量化等各项性能
  指标的出色呈现。

  为了保证产品批量生产的一致性和品质，绿控建立了国际先进的定转子自动化生产线、电机及控制器的自动装配
  线，引进了先进的变速器磨齿加工设备，以及高精度的壳体加工设备；并采用全自动的测量仪器对各零件进行严
  格的检测，通过台架、路试车辆对下线的总成进行综合检验，从而满足客户对产品的高质量要求。

# 关于绿控

## 新能源商用车驱动系统解决方案提供商

苏州绿控传动科技股份有限公司，成立于2011年，是中国新能源商用车电驱动系统领域的领军企业之一。

公司专注于为客户提供高性能的电驱动系统、核心零部件及相关技术开发服务，凭借在驱动电机、变速器和控制系
统方面掌握的一系列关键核心技术，赋予了产品高可靠性、高效率、一体化与轻量化的显著优势。公司的自主研发
成果，覆盖纯电动、插电式混合动力（含增程式）及燃料电池三种技术路线，广泛应用于商用车与非道路移动机械
领域，并在新能源重卡细分市场占据重要地位。

  [探索更多**>**][51]
  
  ## 电机

  [探索更多**>**][52]
  
  ## 变速器
  
  绿控自主设计生产的商用车及矿卡专用变速器。效率高、可靠性强、维护方便
  
  [探索更多**>**][53]

*技术**创新***
  绿控拥有一支高水平的研发和产业化团队，核心研发管理人员均来自国内985、211高校及高端研究机构，主要管
  理层都有着丰富的新能源汽车动力系统的设计、生产及管理经验。

  我们拥有从零件到部件、再到总成的产品开发全周期的验证能力，从设计之初到试制阶段、直到产品批量上市，
  始终贯穿的台架以及整车测试，为产品研发水平的持续提升，提供了坚实的科技保障。
  绿控建立了国内一流的产品开发实验平台；拥有130多台先进的试验设备、70多辆试验车，以及专业完善的实验
  测试流程。绿控的各类产品，采用国际先进的PLM管理系统、通过完全正向开发，经过浸水、高低温、盐雾、振
  动、耐久、噪音、整车路试等146种试验的检验测试，实现了产品可靠性、经济性、动力性、轻量化等各项性能
  指标的出色呈现。

  为了保证产品批量生产的一致性和品质，绿控建立了国际先进的定转子自动化生产线、电机及控制器的自动装配
  线，引进了先进的变速器磨齿加工设备，以及高精度的壳体加工设备；并采用全自动的测量仪器对各零件进行严
  格的检测，通过台架、路试车辆对下线的总成进行综合检验，从而满足客户对产品的高质量要求。

# We Design, Build & Maintain Our Nation's Infrastructure Network

## Our Values

### Safety

Safety is paramount in the electrical industry, and at Pike, each one of us takes our commitment to
safety extremely seriously. At Pike, we don’t just say we’re committed to a safety culture. We
believe in it, instill it, and live by it. Our numbers speak for themselves.

### Integrity

We work hard to be a company where employees are proud to be part of the team, and customers trust
us. Since our inception in 1945, we’ve built our reputation on dealing fairly and honestly in our
business transactions and relationships, and that legacy is at the core of our company’s culture.

### Solutions

Pike is an Energy Solutions Company with turnkey services including engineering, design,
construction and maintenance of transmission, distribution and substations up to 500 kV. We tailor
our approach to fit each of our customers’ project needs, especially as the marketplace is evolving.

## Over 100,000 Lattice Towers Manufactured

Stella-Jones now leverages the expertise of Locweld, a leading manufacturer of steel lattice towers,
serving as a cornerstone of the North American electrical grid since 1947. With a history of
manufacturing more than 100,000 lattice towers—supporting over 20,000 miles of transmission lines
across the United States and Canada—we proudly strengthen the electrical infrastructures that
connect our communities.


Stella-Jones’ commitment to quality, precision, and reliability continues as we expand into steel
lattice structures.

# Airedale by Modine

## The Critical Cooling Specialists

At Airedale by Modine, we believe that air conditioning has a critical role to play in an
ever-changing world. We also passionately believe that air conditioning manufacturers must play a
responsible role in an era where sustainability is key to the preservation of our planet.

Whether you need to maintain productive and healthy working environments for people or optimised
operating envelopes for critical equipment in data centers and other industries, Airedale by Modine
delivers a tailored solution based on world-class products, industry-leading design, intelligent
software, and unrivalled end-to-end customer support.

#### About Us

Tengshida(Hebei) Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd
Tengshida (Hebei) Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer specializing in the
development and production of industrial chimneys and environmental protection equipment. Located in
Longhua Industrial Park, Hengshui City, Hebei Province, the company has a registered capital of RMB
100 million and occupies an area of 100,000 square meters, including 28,000 square meters of
construction space and 3,600 square meters of office space. The company's product range encompasses
self-standing chimneys, telescopic chimneys, tower chimneys, stainless steel chimneys, FRP chimneys,
and numerous other types. Tengshida employs 89 staff members, among whom are eight engineers holding
master’s degrees or higher, with 60% of employees possessing bachelor’s or associate degrees.

## [Best Electrical Engineering Books: Our Top 7 Reads of 2024][73]

[April 6, 2020May 26, 2024][74]
[[best electrical engineering books]][75]

If you’re looking to learn all about electronics and electrical engineering – you’ve come to the
right place.

Electrical4U is dedicated to the teaching and sharing of all things related to electrical and
electronics engineering.

To learn about basic Electrical Engineering, check out our articles on [Voltage][76], [Current][77],
[Transformers][78], [Single Phase Transformers][79], [Step Down Transformers][80], [Step Up
Transformers][81], [Alternators][82], [DC Motors][83], [Induction Motors][84], [Star Delta
Starter][85], [Lenz’s law][86], [Faraday’s law][87], and [DOL Starters][88]. We also review the
[best electrical engineering books][89].

To learn about basic Electronics Engineering, check out our articles on [Buchholz Relay][90],
[RTDs][91], [Diodes][92], [Thermistors][93], [High Pass Filters][94], [Active Low Pass Filters][95],
[Band pass filters][96], [Oscillators][97], [Gray Code][98], [Half Wave Rectifiers,][99]
[Piezoelectric Transducer][100], and [Maxwell Bridges][101].

To learn more about [Control Engineering][102], check out our articles on [Control Systems][103],
[Programmable Logic Controllers][104] (PLCs), [SCADA Systems][105], [Nyquist Plot][106], and [Bode
Plot][107].

We also explore closely related physics topics such as the [Schrodinger Wave Equation][108], [Biot
Savart Law][109], and the [Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle][110].

And if you’re not sure where to start when it comes to learning electrical engineering and
increasing your electrical knowledge, [join our (free) email list][111].

[

## Electrical Engineering MCQs

][112]Need help preparing for your exams? **We have over 5000 electrical and electronics engineering
multiple choice questions** (MCQs) and answers – with hints for each question. MCQs in all
electrical engineering subjects including analog and digital communications, control systems, power
electronics, electric circuits, electric machines – and much more.
[

## Electric Motor Articles

][113]We discuss various types of electric motors including DC Motors, Induction Motors, Synchronous
Motors, and other special types of motors. We explain the working principles, characteristics, uses
and testing of electric motors. This category is a collection of electrical knowledge about all
things related to electric motors.
[

## Electrical Measurement Articles

][114]We discuss various types of electrical and electronic measurements. An explanation of
different bridge circuits, sensors, cathode ray oscilloscopes, digital meters, potentiometers,
transducers, and more. We explain working principles of various measuring instruments and measuring
systems.
[

## Electronics Devices Articles

][115]Learn about the many different types of electronic devices. We go over basic electronics,
semiconductors, diodes, transistors, LEDS, [Printed Circuit Boards][116], MOSFETS, and more.
[

  我们拥有从零件到部件、再到总成的产品开发全周期的验证能力，从设计之初到试制阶段、直到产品批量上市，
  始终贯穿的台架以及整车测试，为产品研发水平的持续提升，提供了坚实的科技保障。
  绿控建立了国内一流的产品开发实验平台；拥有130多台先进的试验设备、70多辆试验车，以及专业完善的实验
  测试流程。绿控的各类产品，采用国际先进的PLM管理系统、通过完全正向开发，经过浸水、高低温、盐雾、振
  动、耐久、噪音、整车路试等146种试验的检验测试，实现了产品可靠性、经济性、动力性、轻量化等各项性能
  指标的出色呈现。

  为了保证产品批量生产的一致性和品质，绿控建立了国际先进的定转子自动化生产线、电机及控制器的自动装配
  线，引进了先进的变速器磨齿加工设备，以及高精度的壳体加工设备；并采用全自动的测量仪器对各零件进行严
  格的检测，通过台架、路试车辆对下线的总成进行综合检验，从而满足客户对产品的高质量要求。

# We Design, Build & Maintain Our Nation's Infrastructure Network

## Our Values

### Safety

Safety is paramount in the electrical industry, and at Pike, each one of us takes our commitment to
safety extremely seriously. At Pike, we don’t just say we’re committed to a safety culture. We
believe in it, instill it, and live by it. Our numbers speak for themselves.

### Integrity

We work hard to be a company where employees are proud to be part of the team, and customers trust
us. Since our inception in 1945, we’ve built our reputation on dealing fairly and honestly in our
business transactions and relationships, and that legacy is at the core of our company’s culture.

### Solutions

Pike is an Energy Solutions Company with turnkey services including engineering, design,
construction and maintenance of transmission, distribution and substations up to 500 kV. We tailor
our approach to fit each of our customers’ project needs, especially as the marketplace is evolving.

poles.

# When The Winds Pass By,

# We Stand Tall

Rohn towers survive under the pressure of hurricane force winds. This tower survived a direct hit
from Hurricane Ike in the Gulf of Mexico, off the coast of Texas.

# When The Winds Pass By,

# We Stand Tall

ROHN has been the trusted name of providing quality engineered *utility structures* since 1948.  One
important distinction of ROHN's manufacturing facility is that we have been certified by the
American Institute of Steel Construction.  This stamp of quality is present on all of our *utility
structures*.

# When The Winds Pass By,

# We Stand Tall

ROHN self-supporting G-Series towers offer an easy, low-cost solution to get light
weight self-supporting* antenna towers* in the air quickly. By using the G-Series tower as a
self-supporting tower, you minimize land area usage.

# When The Winds Pass By,

# We Stand Tall

ROHN Products has extensive experience in manufacturing *wind turbine towers* in support of wind
energy applications. Whatever the requirements, ROHN has the answer.

# When The Winds Pass By,

# We Stand Tall

ROHN structures have evolved on pace with the evolution of communications.  Our first structures
supported antenna for television reception decades ago.  Since then, small radio communication, ham
radio, emergency communication, cellular, PCS and broadband have all found homes on ROHN towers and
poles.

# When The Winds Pass By,

# We Stand Tall

By using ROHN as your single source turnkey communications provider you can increase your efficiency
while reducing cost. Our construction group has direct and immediate access to company management,
engineering, production and shipment to provide you with the highest quality products and widest
range of services.

# When The Winds Pass By,

# We Stand Tall

The ROHN broadband **poles** are a series of pre-engineered poles.  Our monopoles are designed for
both direct embedment at the base with a quick aggregate backfill or a typical foundation design.

# When The Winds Pass By,

# We Stand Tall

No matter where you travel, throughout the world, ROHN is the recognized leader in tower
manufacturing.  If you have a project, we’ve been there and done that.

# 17 Years of Expertise in Steel Tower Manufacturing

[LEARN MORE][32]

## Your Global Steel Tower Experts

Located in the southwest of China, X.Y. Tower is a leading steel tower manufacturer with 180
dedicated employees and an annual production capacity of 40,000 tons. We specialize in a wide range
of high-quality steel structures, including angular transmission line towers, angular
telecommunication towers, monopole towers, steel fittings, and substation structures. Since our
first international sale in 2017, we have accumulated 7 years of extensive overseas experience,
serving customers across Africa, Southeast Asia, South America, and Europe.

Our state-of-the-art galvanizing factory ensures that our products meet the highest standards of
galvanized layer thickness and surface finish, guaranteeing durability and quality.
